TopicSummary: Question: Should the organization keep remote work?

Dataset.Text: I support keeping the remote work policy because flexibility, focus time, reduced commuting, and wider access to roles can improve work outcomes. The policy still needs safeguards for mentoring access and promotion visibility. Greece Greece respondent.
